title: Freelance Invoice Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Create a freelance invoice for any kind of work in your browser. No sign-up. Rights, late fee, PDF, Word and Excel. State freelance laws and 1099 notes.
lede_html: Use this form for design, code, video, translation or any other freelance work, and download a PDF, Word or Excel file. No account. The sample is a logo and site job. Replace it.
demand: how to write an invoice for freelance work

sample.pay: Zelle or ACH to Jon Park
sample.rights: Final logo files transfer to the client on full payment. Source files stay with the designer.
sample.lateFee: Interest applies after the due date as our contract states.

labels.bizId: Tax ID, if the client needs it

form.tax_hint: Enter a rate only if your state taxes your service. The form does not decide this.

must_show.heading: What a freelance invoice must show
must_show.intro_html: A freelance invoice says who you are, what you delivered, what is left to pay, by when, and how. It also says what the client owns. The IRS names invoices among the supporting documents that you keep for your books.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters when you work alone
rows: Your legal name or business name
Use the name on your W-9, so that a finance team can match the payment.
Name files, pages or hours, not only "services".
Show what the client already paid.
New York law sets a default of 30 days when the contract sets no date.
Print only what your contract allows.

line_items.heading: Common freelance jobs and US wage ranges
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row, and the button adds a sample inside it. These are wages of employees, not freelance rates. Set your own rate: you also pay your own taxes, insurance and unpaid time.
line_items.range_label: Employee wage range, May 2023 (10th to 90th percentile)

rules.heading: Freelance rules that touch the invoice

items.title: New York State
items.html: With no payment date in the contract, payment is due within 30 days after you finish (section 1411). Section 1410 sets an $800 floor, over 120 days, and excludes construction contractors.

items.title: New York City
items.html: The city says that contracts worth $800 or more must be in writing, with the work, the pay and the payment date. It says that a worker may collect double the unpaid amount for late payment.

items.title: California
items.html: SB 988 requires a written contract for professional services of $250 or more, with payment due within 30 days after completion if the contract sets no date.

faq.q: What should I do when a client asks for a W-9?
faq.a: Send it. Form W-9 gives the person who files an information return your correct taxpayer number.

faq.q: How do I show a deposit that I already got?
faq.a: Enter it in the deposit field. The total, the amount paid and the balance due then print on the file.

faq.q: Can I charge a late fee?
faq.a: Print the rate from your contract on the invoice. Check the rule for your state.

faq.q: Do I keep a copy of each invoice?
faq.a: Keep it with your records. The IRS says to keep records for 3 years, unless one of its named longer periods applies.
